added.summary: HTML core controls: a plain <input type="checkbox"> is a check box (indeterminate a dash; switch keeps the switch), <input type="radio" value bind:group> radios, <input type="number"> with -og-stepper: buttons a stepper, <menu> of menu items; onhold (data-hold ms), oncontextmenu (secondary press or long press), ontoggle and onclose fire.

breaking.change: <input type="checkbox"> without switch draws HTML's check box, not a switch.
breaking.fix: Add switch to a checkbox that should stay a switch: <input type="checkbox" switch>.
